edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable, establishing the privilege source.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so caller controls the ownership claim.
newOwner state variable is the authorization target checked by acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner, transferring contract privilege.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handoff.
FitShibaInu constructor sets the symbol state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor sets the name state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor sets the decimals state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor mints the whole supply into the deployer balance entry.
transfer debits and credits using msg.sender as the source balance key.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] before the debit.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping for sender and recipient.
to parameter is used as the destination balance key in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowance under the msg.sender key.
approve mutates the allowed nested mapping.
spender parameter is the inner key of allowed in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored in approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
from parameter is the source balance key in transferFrom.
to parameter is the destination balance key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key of balanceOf.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key of allowance.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burn balance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] that can underflow.
approveAndCall writes the allowance under the msg.sender key.
approveAndCall mutates the allowed nested mapping before the external call.
spender parameter keys the allowance entry in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approveAndCall.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract after the allowance state write, enabling reentrancy.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
onlyOwner reads owner to gate transferAnyERC20Token.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner before transferAnyERC20Token runs.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted target of the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount of the external token call.
safeAdd operand a feeds the checked addition.
safeAdd operand b feeds the checked addition and overflow require.
safeAdd assigns the result to local c.
safeSub operand a feeds the checked subtraction.
safeSub operand b feeds the underflow require.
safeSub assigns the result to local c.
safeMul operand a feeds the checked multiplication.
safeMul operand b feeds the checked multiplication.
safeMul assigns the result to local c.
safeDiv numerator a feeds the checked division.
safeDiv denominator b feeds the require(b > 0) guard.
safeDiv assigns the result to local c.
